question: The Global Gender Gap Report primarily measures disparities between genders in which key areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Politics, Economy, Health, Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Global Gender Gap Report, published annually by the **World Economic Forum (WEF)**, measures gender-based disparities in four key areas: **Politics, Economy, Health, and Education**.
 
• It uses a comprehensive framework to evaluate countries on how effectively they are closing gender gaps across these four dimensions.
 
• The report assigns a Gender Gap Index score between 0 (complete inequality) and 1 (complete equality) for each country.
 
• In the political domain, factors such as the percentage of women in parliamentary and ministerial positions are considered.
 
• In the economic domain, the report assesses metrics like workforce participation, wage equality, and leadership roles.
 
• The health dimension examines life expectancy and the gender gap in survival rates, while education focuses on literacy rates and access to education at all levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Economic Forum (WEF) releases several major annual reports, including:** 

 
 
• Global Risks Report: Identifies and analyzes the most critical global risks, drawing from expert surveys.
 
• Future of Jobs Report: Explores how technology and socio-economic shifts are reshaping jobs and required skills.
 
• Global Gender Gap Report: Benchmarks progress on gender equality in four key areas (Economic Participation, Education, Health, Politics).
 
• Top 10 Emerging Technologies: Spotlights technologies with the potential to positively impact society.
 
• Global Cybersecurity Outlook: Examines cybersecurity trends affecting economies and societies.
 
• Global Competitiveness Report: Assesses national competitiveness.
